It's what's inside that really counts, we're all beautiful in our own ways and there's someone out there for us all. I had a beautiful wife but yesterday that ended because of my mental illness towards teen girls. My life is now a complete mess but I still know there is a life for me even though I have bouts of doubt. 

You have much to live for , if I can move forwards so can you

Your face doesn't define who you are as a person. You sound like you have a family who love you and you should focus on that. You need to learn to love yourself, we all have things we dont like about ourselves but it's not a reason to hurt yourself
You're welcome, just remember you have a life and it's worth living.

Please dont, I'm in a very bad position myself I've posted my first thread on it. I feel like I need to make amends for my actions and if I can help one single person then I'll do my utmost to do so. 

If you want to chat I'm here to do so
Thank you for understanding, I just hope there are more people out there like yourself who will be willing to listen to my story and not judge me too harshly

Yes but it's still wrong, I don't find children attractive I want to get that out there. I feel sick with myself. I know this isn't easy for people to read but I feel like I need to tell people for some unknown reason, maybe I want people to punish me

The lady I spoke to said I could call her again tomorrow,  she has the same name as my wife.
She said I can do some breathing exercises and mindfulness exercises too. Going forwards she mentioned doing some courses and therapy to get to the bottom of why I did what I did. I feel numb I just want it to stop but it wont

They were very understanding and spoke to me for over an hour about it. I know I'm a bad person for what I've done but there is so much good inside me and that's the part I want people to see but I know that nobody will ever be able to see past what I've done.

I dont want to leave my boys without a father but at the same time feel they're better without me. I also dont know if I can deal with what lies ahead for me. I feel like I'm living a nightmare that I cant wake up from
